landing.runtimes: Open source under Apache 2.0. Works with Codex, Claude Code, Pi, and OpenCode.
landing.page_title: Relay — Put AI agents to work on your own computers
landing.headline: Put AI agents to work on your own computers
landing.lede: Install Relay on a laptop or a server, then hand work to agents and teams that run there. Follow their work and review results from your desktop or phone.
landing.hero_alt: Relay Home with an Up next queue, running work, and upcoming dates
landing.hero_mobile_alt: Relay Home on a phone, with work needing attention and mobile navigation
landing.step_enroll_body: Install Relay on a laptop or a managed server. Agents run on the computer you connect, directly or in a BoxLite sandbox, never inside the Relay backend.
landing.step_assign_body: Start a thread, file a task, or schedule an automation. Send it to one agent, or to a team that builds, reviews, and hands off.
landing.step_review_body: Follow reasoning, commands, and file changes live. When an agent needs a decision, the task waits for you.
landing.tour_threads_body: Work with an agent or team on the computer you choose. Follow reasoning, commands, and file changes live. Stop, retry, or hand off work as needed.
landing.tour_threads_alt: A Relay thread: one agent has fixed a bug and handed it to a second agent, whose review is streaming live
landing.tour_projects_body: Give project agents a shared workspace on one computer. Track every task on one board, from backlog to completed.
landing.tour_projects_alt: A Relay project board from backlog to done
landing.tour_tasks_body: One task list across projects, with queues for work needing attention, blocked work, and overdue tasks. Each task keeps its runs and output files.
landing.tour_tasks_alt: The Relay tasks list grouped by project
landing.tour_automations_body: Trigger work on a schedule, from task or run events, through a webhook, or with Run now. Each run goes to its assigned agent or team and keeps its history.
landing.tour_automations_alt: The Relay automations list with cadence and next run
landing.tour_teams_body: Choose Solo, Build and review, Pipeline, or Lead-led collaboration. Clear roles and handoffs show who did what.
landing.tour_teams_alt: A Relay team profile with members and responsibilities
landing.principle_local_body: Agents run on connected local or cloud computers. The Relay backend coordinates their work and records the results.
landing.principle_human_body: Agents can ask structured questions when they need your input. Review results, accept completed work, or request changes.
landing.principle_record_body: Review requests, runs, generated files, and token usage together in the thread history. Give work scoped access to GitHub issue reads through Connections.
landing.principle_runtime_body: Codex, Claude Code, Pi, and OpenCode run side by side. Relay MCP lets agents manage standalone tasks and automations; Project Leads can manage project work.
landing.oss_body: Relay is open source under Apache-2.0. Self-host the backend, connect your own computers, and follow development on GitHub.
landing.cta_title: Start with one computer and one agent
landing.cta_body: Relay is opening to teams in batches. Request access, or sign in if you already have an account.
landing.cta_body_signin: Sign in to your Relay account to start a thread.
landing.foot_tagline: Coding agents on your own computers

login.lede: Named agents, a shared record, and your say on what ships.
login.lede_bootstrap: Paste the RELAY_ADMIN_TOKEN from the backend startup log, then create an admin account.
login.cover_headline: Put AI agents to work on your own computers
login.no_bootstrap: Setup is already complete. Sign in.
login.error_generic: Could not sign you in. Check your connection and try again.
login.do_assign: Hand agents threads, tasks, and automations.
login.do_watch: Watch every command as it runs.
login.do_control: Review results and decide what happens next.
login.reset_done: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.

waitlist.title: Request access
waitlist.lede: Relay is opening to a few teams at a time. Tell us what you’d hand off first, and we’ll email an invite when there’s room.
waitlist.confirm_body: Thanks. If this address can be invited, we’ll email an invite when there’s room.
waitlist.name: Name
waitlist.use_case: What would you hand off to an agent?
waitlist.problem_invalid: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
waitlist.error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Use a different email.
waitlist.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
waitlist.error_closed: We’re not taking new requests right now. Try again later.
waitlist.error_unavailable: Relay isn’t taking requests for access here.
waitlist.join_dead_title: This invite link no longer works
waitlist.join_dead_body: It may have been used, replaced by a newer invite, or expired. Request access again and we’ll send a new one when there’s room.
waitlist.handle_invalid: Use 2–64 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores, starting with a letter or number.
waitlist.password_problem_identifier: Must not contain your username, name, or email.
waitlist.password_problem_degenerate: Must not be one repeated character or a straight keyboard sequence.
waitlist.cover_headline: Come back to work that moved while you were away
waitlist.cover_lede: Agents on your own computers take the repetitive work, show every command they run, and stop to ask before anything ships.
waitlist.vignette_running_title: Drafting release notes from merged PRs
waitlist.vignette_waiting_title: Billing migration is ready. Ship it?
waitlist.idea_triage: Triage new bug reports each morning
waitlist.idea_release: Draft release notes from merged PRs
waitlist.idea_tests: Fix flaky tests and open a pull request
waitlist.next_invite: We open Relay to a few teams at a time and email your invite.
waitlist.next_account: The invite link creates your account.
waitlist.next_handoff: Connect a computer and hand your first task to an agent.

password_reset.request_lede: Enter your username or account email. If it matches, we’ll email you a reset link.
password_reset.problem_too_long: That’s longer than any username or email we accept.
password_reset.sent_body: If an account matches, we’ve sent a link to its email address. The link works once and expires soon.
password_reset.ask_admin: No email? Your Relay admin can create a reset link for you.
password_reset.unavailable: Password reset by email isn’t available here. Ask your Relay admin for a reset link.
password_reset.choose_for: For @{{username}}. This signs you out everywhere.
password_reset.dead_body: Reset links work once and expire after a short time. Ask for a new one.
password_reset.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
